required_manual_checks.description: gateCommandForFreeze (tools/agent/lib/gates.mjs) maps gate:static and gate:server to `gate-proof.mjs verify-phase <phase>` (exact-tree receipt verification, as its own comment states: 'Prove executes selected phases. Freeze verifies their receipts'), but gate:db falls through to its registry command `npm run gate:db`, which re-executes the full db phase inside freeze. That needs production database inputs in the freeze shell (outside the orchestrator's sanctioned input handling) and contacts production a second time. On 2026-09-30, 2A.3a-2's freeze failed at gate:db with all 79 PROVEN receipts valid for its tree ab91d92; GATE-2G1-005 and -006 froze only because gate:db executed in a shell that held the inputs (manifests: 48532 ms and 169294 ms).

Add 'gate:db':'db' to the freeze phase mapping, with the same guard the other two have (the registry command must be exactly ['npm','run','gate:db'] with cwd apps/os, else refuse). Freeze then runs `gate-proof.mjs verify-phase db` against the exact tree. prove, gate-proof.mjs, the gate registry (gates.json) and the npm scripts are unchanged: `npm run gate:db` still executes the phase when a human or prove runs it.

Coordinator tests (node --test, no database, no network): gateCommandForFreeze returns verify-phase db for gate:db and refuses a registry entry whose command or cwd differs; static and server mappings are byte-identical to before; typecheck is still executed as its registry command. Using gate-proof.mjs verify-phase db against a synthetic receipt store for a synthetic tree (or the existing receipt helpers): exact-tree valid receipts are accepted; a receipt for another tree, a tampered receipt, and a missing suite are each refused. The freeze command for gate:db is invoked with an environment containing no ASCEND_DATABASE_URL*, ASCEND_TEST_DATABASE_URL, PG* or SUPABASE* name and still succeeds when receipts are valid, and it opens no network connection (assert by environment and by the command being verify-phase, which reads only the local receipt store). Mutant: removing the gate:db mapping turns a test red.

No change to what prove executes, to receipt format or signing, to which gates tasks require, or to recovery handling. Recovery receipts remain covered by prove --owner and the aggregate, not by freeze, unless a task lists them; this task does not add them. The GATE-2G1-006 N2 overlap-test follow-up is out of scope.

Value-free: reproduction of the freeze failure mode with synthetic receipts (before), the test results and the mutant (after). Diff limited to the write paths. After promotion, 2A.3a-2 rebases, re-proves its new exact tree (agent phases and owner recovery), and freezes by verifying receipts.

title: COORD-FREEZE-DB-001 Verify exact-tree DB receipts at freeze instead of re-executing gate:db
